events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Join us in celebrating the one and only Liam Gallagher turning 54. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971, featuring his most famous peace anthem.

angles.name: Imagine 55 years
angles.copy: 55 years ago, John Lennon gave the world a masterpiece. 'Imagine' remains a powerful message of peace and unity. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First Apple iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music and paving the way for digital music players.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? It's 25 years since Apple launched the original iPod! Did you have one of these game-changers, and what was the first album you loaded onto it?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British secret agent and the release of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007 with a look back at the best Bond theme tunes. Which one gets your vote for ultimate secret agent anthem?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have marked the 86th birthday of music legend and peace activist John Lennon, who was born in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His legacy of music, peace, and love continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel chaos, what's your favourite moment from this British comedy icon?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968, showcasing their diverse musical styles.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'! A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What are your standout tracks from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost a true rock icon. His voice, showmanship, and spirit remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, marking a significant shift in their musical direction.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Sound
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history! 61 years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, showcasing their evolving sound. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon, a musical visionary and advocate for peace, who was murdered in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: 46 years ago, the world fell silent. Remembering John Lennon, whose powerful music and message of peace continue to resonate. His spirit lives on.
